name: 29070-prefillheavy-dsv4flashfp8-tp8
model: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 -- substituted for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, whose published H100 layout starts at two nodes. Ungated, 294.0 GB, not in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 43 layers, 284B total parameters, 256-expert MoE (top-6, one shared), block-wise FP8 weights (weight_block_size [128,128]); 294.0 GB over 46 shards, ~36.8 GB per rank at TP8. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 600 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket: a fixed 1024-token prompt and a fixed 128-token generation, both stdev 0, with `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true` under `backend.extras.body`. Radix cache is off, so every prompt is prefilled in full.
purpose: A document-analysis assistant on a 284-billion-parameter model, serving eight concurrent streams of long prompts with short replies on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line: the reader takes the file line by line and
# skips indented ones, so a re-flowed or nested block is DROPPED silently and the engine starts
# without it. The interpreter for this commit is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.

model-path: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8
tp-size: 8

# `breakable` is the CUDA default for the prefill phase, but the engine runs a compatibility
# cascade over that default which turns prefill capture off for this architecture on capture-pool
# memory grounds. Naming the backend explicitly skips the cascade; leave this line out and the
# server runs with prefill capture disabled.
cuda-graph-backend-prefill: breakable

# Prefill capture ceiling in tokens, and the chunk budget matched to it, so every prefill batch
# this workload forms lands inside a captured bucket. If capture OOMs, see env.yaml.
cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill: 2048
chunked-prefill-size: 2048

# Headroom for the capture pool on an 80 GB card; the KV footprint here is trivial.
mem-fraction-static: 0.75

# A prefix cache hit skips the prefill this setup measures.
disable-radix-cache: true

# Everything else is stock: attention-backend, dtype, context-length, max-running-requests,
# decode-side cuda-graph-max-bs, swa-full-tokens-ratio, ep-size / dp-size / pp-size. host, port
# and served-model-name are owned by the serving layer. Nothing is tuned.
